description: Bottom-contact support overlaps reduce extrusion height and flow with a positive-gap versus zero-gap control.

mutants.description: Return from the public overlap-modulation helper even when a bottom-contact path has overlapping support layers; the positive-gap row must lose its reduced-height interface fragment.
Use the current layer height for every clipped fragment instead of the vertical distance to the overlap; the positive-gap row must no longer expose a reduced-height path.
Compute clipped fragment flow from the untrimmed source height; the positive-gap row must lose the lower flow associated with its reduced-height fragment.
